purpose: Prevent repeated research on bounded mechanisms that failed chronological stress screens.

Every representative long and short configuration was negative in fit; short PF was approximately 0.61 to 0.76.
No entry hour, direction, stop, and target combination passed the fit stress screen.
No rolling basis tail, trade direction, or 30-second flow confirmation passed the first chronological year.
No long or short daily breakout/trailing-exit configuration passed fit.
No direction, trend horizon, RSI tail, stop, and holding-period combination passed fit.

interpretation: R1 remains the only credible price-mechanical near-survivor. These failures do not authorize inverted rules, threshold repairs, or trading promotion.
